3. Provide a note on delegation: when creating sub‑tasks, the agent must also set `assigneeAgentId` (found via `paperclip_list_agents`), otherwise the sub‑task will be ignored.

These instructions directly address the pattern I observed and will be enforced every time the agent runs a task. To implement this, I’ll edit `execute.js`, targeting the exact line containing the disposition warning, and insert the new strings after it, preserving the original warning.

Thus, I’ll issue an Edit tool call on `/home/lane/.paperclip/adapter-plugins/groq-paperclip-adapter-r8/dist/server/execute.js`, replacing the old string with the same string plus the four new instruction strings, each quoted and separated by commas as required by the JavaScript array syntax.
